operations.summary: Create a durable control upgrade rollout
operations.description: Requires control.upgrades.manage in a platform scope. The canonical request freezes the sorted target cohort, canary subset, batch size, and mandatory automatic rollback. A replay rechecks live RBAC and returns the original durable snapshot without another license call or NATS publication. A changed request under the same idempotency key returns 409.

fields.name: node_ids
fields.description: Canonical lowercase UUIDs in strictly increasing byte order.

fields.name: canary_node_ids
fields.description: One or two strictly sorted canonical UUIDs, each also present in node_ids.
